questions.stem: Identify all primary tissue classes in human histology: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: 4 primary tissues: Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Nervous.

questions.stem: Which cell junctions join adjacent epithelial cells together? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Epithelial junctions = Tight, Adherens, Desmosome, Gap.

questions.stem: Identify all formed blood elements in circulating bloodstream: (Select all that apply)
Identify all features belonging to Skeletal Muscle histology: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Skeletal muscle is voluntary, syncytial, striated, subject to fatigue.

questions.stem: Which structures contain Hyaline Cartilage extracellular matrix? (Select all that apply)
options: A) Articular ends of long bones
answers: A) Articular ends of long bones
questions.explanation: Hyaline cartilage lines articular ends, nose, ribs, trachea.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Easy deck, select all tissue layers formed by Simple Columnar Epithelium: (Select all that apply)
options: B) Lining of small intestine with microvilli brush border
D) Lining of Fallopian tubes (Ciliated variant)
answers: B) Lining of small intestine with microvilli brush border
D) Lining of Fallopian tubes (Ciliated variant)
questions.explanation: Simple columnar lines stomach, intestine, gall bladder, and Fallopian tubes.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Easy deck, select all key properties of Connective Tissue: (Select all that apply)
options: B) Vascular blood supply in CT proper
C) Connects and supports other tissues
E) Avascular tightly packed sheets with no matrix
answers: B) Vascular blood supply in CT proper
C) Connects and supports other tissues
questions.explanation: Connective tissue has abundant matrix, vascular supply (except cartilage), mesodermal origin.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Easy deck, identify all functions of Leucocytes (WBCs): (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: WBCs perform immune protection via phagocytosis, antibody production, and inflammatory defense.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Easy deck, select all structural parts of a typical Multipolar Neurone: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Neurones consist of Cyton, Dendrites, Axon, and Nissl's granules.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Easy deck, select all exocrine glands classified by morphology: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Exocrine glands include unicellular goblet cells, simple tubular, compound alveolar, and tubulo-alveolar glands.
